summary: John's maternal 2nd great-grandmother; a foundling ('figlia di padre ignoto e madre ignota') born at Sant'Angelo dei Lombardi c.1873, wife of Frank Giannetta and mother of Mollie.
bio: Not in the Ancestry tree; identified in Round 2. FS tree LCPG-FC6: born about 1874 in Bisaccia, immigrated 1909, died in Dunmore 1950. Mollie's 1931 license gives the mother as Angeli(c)a, maiden name 'Ferrandino', born in Italy; 'Angelina Genett' consented to the marriage. Frank's 1920 Declaration of Intention says his wife Angelina was born in Italy. Round 3 read the marriage act (Bisaccia, 1 Aug 1896, Matrimoni 1896 act 18): bride aged 23 (so born c.1873), born in Sant'Angelo dei Lombardi, resident in Bisaccia, 'figlia di padre ignoto e madre ignota' - i.e. a foundling; the surname Ferrantino was given to her by the authorities. Sant'Angelo dei Lombardi was a district seat with a foundling wheel (ruota); 'Ferrantino' is typical of names given to esposti. Her parents are unknown. The Sant'Angelo dei Lombardi registers on Antenati stop at 1865, so her foundling birth act (c.1873, probably via the ruota) cannot be reached there.
openQuestions: Foundling (esposti) records of Sant'Angelo dei Lombardi c.1873, Archivio di Stato di Avellino
